## Domain notes

- One Postgres instance, shared with the reporting job. The reporting job reads
  `notes` directly, so a column rename breaks it silently — check `.agent-kit/docs/ARCH_MAP.md`.
- `share_tokens` rows are created by the invitation flow only; nothing else may write there.
- The API is public and versioned in the path. `/v1` responses are frozen for one year.
